crossRefs.note: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

people.name: Zoar
people.line: A city near Sodom, spared from destruction

translations.web: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
translations.bsb: And by the time the sun had risen over the land, Lot had reached Zoar.
translations.kjv: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
translations.asv: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot came unto Zoar.
